Ram Temple Trust Faces Scrutiny Amid Allegations of Donation Theft

Allegations of theft of cash, jewelry, and other valuables offered by devotees have surfaced at Ayodhya's Ram Temple. The Ram Mandir Trust has reshuffled leadership following the scandal, with a key figure resigning. Authorities are investigating, and political accusations have been exchanged.
